data.name: Zombie Shooter Kit
data.detailed_description:
Zombie Shooter Kit is a fully replicated Unreal Engine 5 blueprint asset pack designed to help you build your own zombie survival game with weapons, inventory, AI enemies, vehicles, crafting, weather, and multiplayer support.

Build your own zombie survival game in Unreal Engine 5 🧟

Zombie Shooter Kit gives solo developers and small teams a powerful foundation for creating survival games, zombie shooters, extraction shooters, open-world survival games, co-op zombie games, and PvP experiences.

Built with over 2 years of passion and development experience, this kit is designed to help you skip the boring groundwork and start building the actual game you want to make.

Inventory, Looting & Crafting 🎒

Zombie Shooter Kit includes a jigsaw-style grid inventory system with multi-slot items, fast drag-and-drop support, item inspection, inventory weight, and encumbrance.

Players can loot containers, boxes, bodies, and enemies using multiplayer-ready looting systems designed for survival gameplay. The kit also includes a crafting system for consumables, components, medical items, and other useful supplies.

Multiplayer, Steam Lobbies & PvP ⚡

Zombie Shooter Kit is fully replicated for multiplayer, making it ready for co-op and PvP projects out of the box.

Create and join multiplayer sessions through Steam Lobby support, switch between first-person and third-person cameras, use ADS-ready camera systems, and build survival games where players can team up, fight each other, or both!

Day, Night & Dynamic Weather 🗺️

Bring your zombie survival world to life with a full day/night cycle and a dynamic weather system.

The kit includes clear days, cloudy days, light rain, heavy rain, and a weighted system for randomized weather changes, helping your levels feel less static and more alive.

Additional Features

Core Gameplay: Health, hunger, thirst, stamina, fall damage, directional hit reactions, player sprinting, door interactions, objectives, missions, loading screens, main menu, and settings menu.

Weapons & Combat: 10 weapons, ranged combat, melee combat, custom melee combos, weapon animations, sounds, particles, red-dot sight, 4x scope, silencer, laser sight, flashlight, gore, dismemberment, and physics-driven explosions.

Equipment & Armor: 9 wearable equipment slots with stats and protection.

Movement & Locomotion: Procedural movement using Epic’s GASP, aim offsets, turn-in-place, jumping, sprinting, crouching, and Parkour Anywhere mantle/climb support across most geometry.

AI & Enemies: 5 customizable zombie enemies, search/chase/attack behaviors, Zombie Horde System, enemy faction AI with cover/shoot/flee behaviors, Metahuman character support, and AI spawner.

Vehicles: Vehicle support included for expanding your survival world with driveable gameplay systems.

Start building today

Zombie Shooter Kit is designed to help you start building your zombie survival game faster.

Try the free playtest, check out the documentation for specific details, join the community Discord, and start building something amazing.

data.short_description: Create your own survival games using the Zombie Shooter Kit! This Unreal Engine 5 template includes everything you need to make any third person or first person game you could ever want! Try out the demo FOR FREE on Steam, and make sure to follow our development blogs for regular updates!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
